symbols.name: Model FLOPs utilization
symbols.meaning: Share of the numerical-path peak that the run spends on model arithmetic.

symbols.name: Achieved model rate
symbols.meaning: About 123 TFLOP/s for ResNet-50 at 5,000 images/s per accelerator.

symbols.name: Hardware peak
symbols.meaning: 989 TFLOP/s dense FP16 on the H100 in this example.

symbols.name: Training time
symbols.meaning: Elapsed time until the run first meets the quality target.

symbols.name: Validation accuracy
symbols.meaning: Measured quality at time t; the target is fixed by the benchmark (75.9% top-1 for ResNet-50).

symbols.name: Earliest meeting time
symbols.meaning: The first instant the target is reached — later gains do not count.

symbols.name: End-to-end speedup
symbols.meaning: The improvement a request actually sees.

symbols.name: Accelerated fraction
symbols.meaning: Share of the serial time the optimized stage owns (10 of 18 ms → 0.56).

symbols.name: Component speedup
symbols.meaning: How much faster the touched stage runs — even infinite speed leaves the other stages.

symbols.name: Energy per inference
symbols.meaning: Joules for one completed request inside the measured window.

symbols.name: Active power
symbols.meaning: Draw during the inference interval only — e.g. 300 W.

symbols.name: Inference time
symbols.meaning: Length of the measured window — e.g. 10 ms gives 3 J.

symbols.name: Duty cycle
symbols.meaning: Fraction of time the accelerator runs inference — 0.8% for keyword spotting.

symbols.name: Active power
symbols.meaning: Draw during inference bursts.

symbols.name: Standby power
symbols.meaning: The idle floor; dominates at low duty.

symbols.name: Load time
symbols.meaning: Physical lower bound before any runtime work.

symbols.name: Model bytes
symbols.meaning: ~14 GB for a 7B-parameter FP16 model.

symbols.name: Effective bandwidth
symbols.meaning: 25 GB/s on PCIe 4.0 here → ~560 ms.

title: Standard error of an accuracy difference

symbols.name: Measured accuracies
symbols.meaning: 95% and 94% on the same evaluation.

symbols.name: Evaluation count
symbols.meaning: 1,000 images; the interval narrows only as N grows.

symbols.name: Standard error
symbols.meaning: The unpaired noise floor — assumes independent samples, which the same-test-set comparison violates.

symbols.name: Baseline-only correct
symbols.meaning: Images the baseline gets right and the compressed model misses.

symbols.name: Compressed-only correct
symbols.meaning: Images the compressed model gets right and the baseline misses.

symbols.name: Test statistic
symbols.meaning: Exceeds 3.84 for significance at 95%; at most 26 disagreements still flag the 10-error gap.
